summary: Revised implementation plan for Stage 5 download engine hardening incorporating user adjustments: non-blocking coordinator lock release before waiting on in-flight tasks, tracked worker completion on resume without REPLACE, conditional queue clearing only when no active/paused items remain, CAS cache tier update accepting NONE or CACHE with timestamp refresh, StatFs for INTERNAL with ENOSPC mapping for SAF, in-memory per-source nextAllowedAt throttle tracking, and in-memory deletingNovelIds guard preventing enqueues during deletion.
